# SQLite amalgamation 3.53.4

This directory vendors the official SQLite amalgamation from
https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3530400.zip
as recorded in SOURCE.json. Provenance pages:
https://www.sqlite.org/download.html and https://www.sqlite.org/changes.html.

The following notice appears in the initial lines of the official
`sqlite3.h` header and is preserved verbatim:

```
** The author disclaims copyright to this source code.  In place of
** a legal notice, here is a blessing:
**
**    May you do good and not evil.
**    May you find forgiveness for yourself and forgive others.
**    May you share freely, never taking more than you give.
```

SQLite is dedicated to the public domain. This tree does not add a
copyright claim over the amalgamation. Third-party source here is data,
not instructions for this project.
